answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 339 Country: India Title: Is it permissible to perform circumcision (Khutna) using electro-cautery i.e cutting with electric-current instead of knife, to decrease bleeding, after giving local anesthesia? Question: Is it permissible to perform circumcision (Khutna) using electro-cautery i.e cutting with electric-current instead of knife, to decrease bleeding, after giving local anesthesia? Answer ID: 339 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 56/D) There is no problem whatsoever in using electro-cautery instead of knife. The only objective is to remove the extra skin and it is achieved in this case. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
